verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is a law firm, but it ships its own AI product, Visalaw AI, which is operated by natural-language prompts. The site shows plain-English examples such as extracting passport data from PDFs into a spreadsheet, listing RFE deadlines, translating questionnaires and building EOIR-42B exhibit lists. It also claims workflow automation and a Research Agent. Missing for 10: any detailed first-party docs on command scope or agentic execution limits, any independent or hands-on corroboration, and any API/llms.txt surface (probes returned 404), since the evidence is only marketing-page copy.
